units.source_text: 源氏的卧室的格子窗尚未打开。

en.t: The lattice windows of Genji's bedroom had not yet been opened.

units.source_text: 夕雾便靠在卧室前的栏杆上，向庭中眺望。

en.t: Yugiri leaned against the railing before the bedroom and gazed out into the garden.

units.source_text: 但见小山上的树木已被吹倒，许多枝条横卧在地上。

en.t: He saw that the trees on the little hill had already been blown down, and many branches lay across the ground.

units.source_text: 各处草花零乱，更不待言。

en.t: Needless to say, the grasses and flowers everywhere were in disorder.

units.source_text: 屋顶上的丝柏皮、瓦片，以及各处的围垣、竹篱，都被吹得乱七八糟。

en.t: The cypress bark and tiles on the roofs, along with the walls and bamboo fences here and there, had all been blown into confusion.

units.source_text: 东方略微透露一点曙色，庭中的露水发出忧郁的闪光，天空中弥漫着凄凉的朝雾。

en.t: A faint hint of dawn showed in the east, the dew in the garden gave off a melancholy glimmer, and a bleak morning mist filled the sky.

units.source_text: 夕雾对此景象，不觉流下泪来。

en.t: At this sight, Yugiri could not help shedding tears.

units.source_text: 连忙举袖拭泪，然后咳嗽几声。

en.t: He quickly raised his sleeve to wipe his tears, then coughed a few times.

units.source_text: 但闻源氏在室内说道：“这是中将的声音呢。

en.t: Then he heard Genji say from inside the room, "That is the lieutenant general's voice.
Has he come already, before daybreak?"

units.source_text: 他就起身，对紫姬说些话。

en.t: He got up and said a few words to Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 听不见紫姬的答话，但闻源氏笑着说：“如此辜负香衾，从来不曾有过。

en.t: Lady Murasaki's reply could not be heard, but Genji was heard laughing as he said, "I have never before treated these fragrant bedclothes so poorly.

units.source_text: 今天使你不快，我很抱歉。”

en.t: I am sorry to have displeased you today."

units.source_text: 两人相与谈话，十分情投意合。

en.t: The two of them talked together, perfectly in sympathy with each other.

units.source_text: 夕雾听不见紫姬的答话，但从隐约听到的调笑的语调中，可以察知这一对夫妻的恩爱。

en.t: Yugiri could not hear Lady Murasaki's replies, but from the faintly audible teasing tone he could sense the affection between the husband and wife.
